entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The petitioners are apprehending their arrest in connection with Littipara P.S. Case No.10 of 2024
registered under Section 341, 323, 324, 325, 307, 379, 504 & 506 of the Indian Penal Code.
2.  Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners have been falsely implicated in the present case and have not committed any offence as alleged in the F.I.R.
The petitioner no.1 is a senior citizen and petitioner nos.2 to 4 are his sons.

The petitioner no.4 is also the son-in-law of the informant, namely, Asgar Ansari and his daughter Aklima Bibi had filed a complaint case under Section 498A of the I.P.C. against the petitioner no.4 in the Court of A.C.J.M., Pakur, which was Tamizuddin Ansari @ Tamijudin Ansari vs The State Of Jharkhand .......... Opp. ... on 9 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79477024/
1 disposed of on the basis of compromise between the parties.

entities.text: Tamizuddin Ansari @ Tamijudin Ansari vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Subsequently, the dispute again arose and on 13th March, 2024 one Bhanu Bibi was assaulted by the informant party.

She informed the said incident to the police on the same day, pursuant to which a notice issued by the police to the informant, however, he did not turn up before the police rather lodged the present case with false allegation.
Under the said circumstance, the petitioners may be given privilege of anticipatory bail.

3. Mr. Prabir Kr. Chatterjee, learned A.P.P., while opposing the petitioners' prayer for grant of anticipatory bail, submits that there is specific allegation against all the petitioners that they assaulted the informant by means of iron rod, knife, lathi etc. due to which he sustained grievous injury.
Under the said circumstance, the petitioners may not be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.
4. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering the nature of allegation made against the petitioners, I am not inclined to enlarge them on anticipatory bail.
5. Accordingly, the present anticipatory bail application is rejected.
(Rajesh Shankar, J.) Vikas Tamizuddin Ansari @ Tamijudin Ansari vs The State Of Jharkhand .......... Opp. ... on 9 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79477024/
